protected_invariants.heading: Purpose
protected_invariants.text: Do not use this capability when the main job is prompt hardening, import classification, architecture design, or durable long-running analysis memory without a behavioral comparison goal.

protected_invariants.heading: Capability Evaluation Contract
protected_invariants.text: bin/capability-eval calibrate --static-only

protected_invariants.heading: Capability Evaluation Contract
protected_invariants.text: Valid statuses are `structural_ready`, `behavioral_pending`, `promote`, `hold`, `blocked_contract`, `inconclusive`, `rollback`, and `stale_evidence`. Never translate a structural UAC result into `promote`.

protected_invariants.heading: Capability Evaluation Contract
protected_invariants.text: Normal CI is `static` and uses zero model tokens. Model-mediated profiles require an explicit operator or workflow gate. A cap breach, missing required runtime, unqualified judge, stale hash, or surviving critical mutant returns `inconclusive`, `hold`, or `stale_evidence`; it never silently narrows the experiment.

protected_invariants.heading: Agent Operating Contract
protected_invariants.text: - prepare change, commit, and merge guidance only after a candidate clears the promotion threshold

protected_invariants.heading: Agent Operating Contract
protected_invariants.text: The agent surface must never imply unconditional runtime authority. It may recommend, prepare, and validate. It must respect human review gates before promotion unless the user explicitly allows automated action inside the host system.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - forbidden: claiming an unmeasured improvement, silently widening the editable scope, hiding regressions behind aggregate scores, or merging changes without explicit policy support

protected_invariants.heading: Example Request
protected_invariants.text: > Use Auto-Research to improve our code-review prompt so it catches behavioral regressions earlier, but do not increase review noise or operator burden.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not start search without a measurable goal.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not claim a winner from a single run unless the system is strictly deterministic and the user agrees.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not hide regressions inside one aggregate “score improved” claim.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not assume the host repo allows auto-commit or auto-merge.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not let the capability degrade into generic brainstorming or generic testing advice.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not confuse public inspiration with local proof.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not promote any candidate whose score is ambiguous, unstable, or unrepeatable.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not run broad candidate search when one sharply framed hypothesis can be tested first.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not parallelize dependent verification steps when regenerated artifacts are involved.
